Scenario.asn1_pkgs: when asn1_prep asn1 install_pkgs emit asn1_pkgs
Scenario.asn1_up: when asn1_pkgs asn1 config_frr_router emit asn1_up
Scenario.asn2_pkgs: when asn2_prep asn2 install_pkgs emit asn2_pkgs
Scenario.asn2_up: when asn2_pkgs asn2 config_frr_router emit asn2_up
Scenario.asn3_pkgs: when asn3_prep asn3 install_pkgs emit asn3_pkgs
Scenario.asn3_up: when asn3_pkgs asn3 config_frr_router emit asn3_up
Scenario.asn4_pkgs: when asn4_prep asn4 install_pkgs emit asn4_pkgs
Scenario.asn4_up: when asn4_pkgs asn4 config_frr_router emit asn4_up
Scenario.client_pkgs: when client_prep client install_pkgs emit client_pkgs
Scenario.client_frr: when client_pkgs client config_frr_host emit client_frr
Scenario.client_up: when client_frr client finalize_client emit client_up
Scenario.server_pkgs: when server_prep server install_pkgs emit server_pkgs
Scenario.server_frr: when server_pkgs server config_frr_host emit server_frr
Scenario.server_up: when server_frr server finalize_server emit server_up
Scenario.attacker_pkgs: when attacker_prep attacker install_pkgs emit attacker_pkgs
Scenario.attacker_frr: when attacker_pkgs attacker config_frr_host emit attacker_frr
Scenario.attacker_up: when attacker_frr attacker finalize_attacker emit attacker_up
Scenario.p1_del2: when asn1_up, asn2_up, asn3_up, asn4_up, client_up, server_up, attacker_up wait 30 asn2 delroute emit d2
Scenario.p1_del3: when asn1_up, asn2_up, asn3_up, asn4_up, client_up, server_up, attacker_up wait 30 asn3 delroute emit d3
Scenario.p1_client: when d2, d3 wait 25 client baseline emit p1_client_done
Scenario.p1_bgp_asn3: when d2, d3 wait 25 asn3 showbgp
Scenario.p1_bgp_asn2: when d2, d3 wait 25 asn2 showbgp
Scenario.p2_hijack: when p1_client_done asn4 do_hijack emit hijacked
Scenario.p2_client: when hijacked wait 150 client observe emit p2_client_done
Scenario.p3_subhijack: when p2_client_done asn4 do_subhijack emit subdone

Bindings.install_pkgs: bash -c "sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install frr net-tools traceroute >/tmp/dew-$nid-pkgs.log 2>&1 && command -v vtysh >/dev/null && command -v traceroute >/dev/null"
Bindings.config_frr_router: bash -c "sudo cp -f /tmp/$nid/confs/$nid/frr/* /etc/frr/ && sudo service frr restart && sleep 3 && systemctl is-active --quiet frr && pgrep -x bgpd >/dev/null"
Bindings.config_frr_host: bash -c "sudo cp -f /tmp/$nid/confs/$nid/frr/* /etc/frr/ 2>/dev/null; sudo service frr restart && sleep 3 && systemctl is-active --quiet frr"
Bindings.finalize_client: bash -c "sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install ftp net-tools >/tmp/dew-$nid-fin.log 2>&1 && (sudo ip route add 0.0.0.0/0 via 10.5.0.1 2>/dev/null; ip route | grep -q '^default') && command -v ftp >/dev/null"
Bindings.finalize_server: bash -c "sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install vsftpd >/tmp/dew-$nid-ftp.log 2>&1 && sudo cp -f /tmp/$nid/confs/$nid/vsftpd/vsftpd.conf /etc/ && sudo cp -f /tmp/$nid/confs/$nid/vsftpd/README /srv/ftp/ && sudo service vsftpd restart && sleep 2 && (sudo ip route add 0.0.0.0/0 via 10.1.1.1 2>/dev/null; ip route | grep -q '^default') && sudo ss -ltn | grep -q ':21 '"
Bindings.finalize_attacker: bash -c "sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install vsftpd >/tmp/dew-$nid-ftp.log 2>&1 && sudo cp -f /tmp/$nid/confs/$nid/vsftpd/vsftpd.conf /etc/ && sudo cp -f /tmp/$nid/confs/$nid/vsftpd/README /srv/ftp/ && sudo service vsftpd restart && sleep 2 && (sudo ip route add 0.0.0.0/0 via 10.6.1.1 2>/dev/null; ip route | grep -q '^default') && sudo ss -ltn | grep -q ':21 '"
Bindings.delroute: bash -c "sudo ip route del 10.1.1.0/24 2>/dev/null; echo ok"
Bindings.baseline: bash -c "{ echo '=== traceroute -n 10.1.1.2 ==='; traceroute -n -w1 -q1 10.1.1.2; echo '=== ping 10.1.1.2 ==='; ping -c2 -W2 10.1.1.2; echo '=== netstat -rn ==='; netstat -rn; echo '=== show ip route ==='; sudo vtysh -c 'show ip route'; echo '=== README ==='; curl -s ftp://anonymous:x@10.1.1.2/README; } > /tmp/client-part1.txt 2>&1"
Bindings.do_hijack: bash -c "sudo bash /tmp/hijack-prefix.sh > /tmp/hijack.log 2>&1 && sudo vtysh -c 'show ip bgp 10.1.1.0/24' | grep -q Local"
Bindings.observe: bash -c "{ echo '=== traceroute -n 10.1.1.2 ==='; traceroute -n -w1 -q1 10.1.1.2; echo '=== netstat -rn ==='; netstat -rn; echo '=== README ==='; curl -s ftp://anonymous:x@10.1.1.2/README; } > /tmp/client-$epoch.txt 2>&1"
Bindings.do_subhijack: bash -c "sudo bash /tmp/hijack-subprefix.sh > /tmp/subhijack.log 2>&1 && sudo vtysh -c 'show ip bgp 10.1.1.0/25' | grep -q Local"
